entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.0
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **The bots can buy upgrades again, and an existing server gets SourceMod's fix for the upgrade station crash.** The 2026-10-02 TF2 update changed how the game stores the messages the upgrade station sends, and the SourceMod we shipped read them the old way. A player opening the station crashed the server, and the game refused every upgrade a bot asked for. SourceMod 1.12.0-git7255 reads the new layout, and the launcher and the Docker image now upgrade a server that already has an older SourceMod at its next start. Your own edits to SourceMod's configs are kept. We measured the bots: 35 of 35 purchases refused before, 44 bought after, and a player confirmed the station no longer crashes their server. - **The debug bundle stops pointing at the wrong thing when SigMod cannot find the game.** When SigMod was made for the TF2 build your server reports and still finds none of the game's addresses, the game files are usually half updated, and `summary.txt` now says so and tells you to press Repair, which checks every game file on the next start. It used to tell you to compare two version numbers that already matched. And when every bot purchase is refused on a SourceMod that already has the fix, it no longer blames SourceMod. ### Changed - **The debug bundle names the TF2 build the server is running.** It listed every version the launcher installs and not the one they are all built against, which is the version that matters most on the evening TF2 updates. - **The debug bundle says when two of those versions cannot work together.** Above the logs it now names, in plain words, a SigMod built for a different TF2 build, a SourceMod too old for the upgrade station on this one, and a run where the game refused every upgrade the bots tried to buy. It compares what the file already said; it still does not claim to have found your bug. - **The debug bundle stops sending you after a crash dump that does not exist.** When SigMod catches the fault and closes the server itself, Windows writes no dump, and the summary now says so and points at the two stacks SigMod printed into the log instead. When a dump should exist it names the folders it looked in. - **The debug bundle lists what it could not collect.** Two bundles from the same evening held different files and there was no way to tell a missing file from a file that never existed. `collected.txt` in the zip now says which it was, and why. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * feat(ci): alert on a new TF2 build before players do by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/181 * fix(versions): pin the defender mod's compiler once, and record the TF2 build by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/182 * fix(deploy): pin SourceMod 1.12.0-git7255 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/183 * feat(debugbundle): record the TF2 build and cross-check the pins against it by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/184 * chore(deps): tf2-mvm-bots-go v0.18.4, and drop SM_Stock_OfficerSpy from the build by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/185 * fix(install): bring an installed SourceMod and Metamod to the pins by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/186 * fix(debugbundle): point at the game files when SigMod fails on its own build by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/187 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.17.9...v1.18.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NzM4ZmE0MThiNjhmNjQ5OGY0OGUzMWU0NzA0ZTZkNTM6MTc5MTEwNTU2OQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/MDdmNmEzNmJkYmE3NmNiZjhhN2Q2Mjg5ZDEzZjgzZWQ6MTc5MTEwNTU3Mg==/detection)

entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.0r2
entry.content:
# Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.0: I Can't Think of a Good Subtitle! You Get This Instead! ## NOTE: AHT v2.2.1 has been released, and should be safe to use with seeds previously generated with v2.2.0. You can find it [here](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/releases/tag/AHT-v2.2.1).
*AHT v2.2 is only compatible with game mod version 20, which is included below (both NTSC + PAL).*
v2.2 contains *way* more than originally planned (sorry for the long changelog...). There's enough left on our to-do list to justify at least a v2.3, though I'm not sure how quick it'll happen. But who are we kidding, I'm scarily addicted to working on AHT...
**KNOWN ISSUE**: I accidentally left a few logging print statements in the client code which processes Bounce traps. I don't think it's worth putting out a tiny .apworld adjustment just to fix that, so I'll probably leave it as-is for now. May change my mind down the road idk.
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ) # Changelog (compared to v2.1.0) ## Most Notable ### Features * The PAL GC version of the game is now supported by the game mod! * The randomized shop system has been moderately redesigned: - `gem_logic` is now `shop_logic` and comes in 2 forms. `ordered` works identically to `gem_logic = true`. `unordered` is a replacement for `gem_logic = false` which avoids all shop items being in sphere 1. `unordered` assumes you will buy items in order, but doesn't restrict you from doing otherwise at your own risk, whereas `ordered` does enforce the order. - Number of shop items is now determined by `shop_item_count` instead of `key_rings`. * The goal system has been heavily expanded. * `auto_corrections` has been expanded to `halt`, `fix_minor`, `fix_major`, and `chaos`. `halt` halts generation on problems. `fix_minor` fixes relatively inconsequential problems. `fix_major` fixes problems with a more notable impact. `chaos` continues generation instead of fixing or halting. * Added support for 5 traps (Spam Call, Reverse Controls, Bounce, Gem Tax, and Damage Sparx)! * You can now teleport across the orbiting platform sections in Cloudy Domain with a button prompt. ### Logic * Added a logical requirement for the critters in Red's boss fight. * The rising statue room in Sunken Ruins now requires Electric Breath to get to anything, instead of only Double Jump. * `RL: Dark Gem in Northeast` now requires the ability to kill the huge robo-gnorcs guarding it. * Fixed a rare math precision error that could make the final shop item never be in logic. * Made a [reference spreadsheet](<https://tinyurl.com/ahtapsheet>) which lists every region and location access rule, to help with troubleshooting. ## Less Notable ### Fixes/Tweaks * `auto_corrections` will now fix or halt if you attempt to generate a seed with no goal, or if you randomize Light Gem door or Gadget costs to be above 90 while `open_world_mode` is `vanilla`. * Fixed a goal bug that hurt Go Mode accuracy and harmed the quality of calculated playthroughs. * Map icons now render as red = unreachable, yellow = reachable, and green = checked. * The pause menu's gem information no longer includes out-of-logic gems (those from Gem Packs/Taxes and Double Gems). * Fixed multiple bugs with how shop unlock items are created and handled logically. * Added location groups for Light Gem doors and gadgets. * In-game notifications now include item sends, and a small Easter egg when you receive specific items from yourself. * `hint_boss_rewards` now hints all boss locations, not just the breath rewards. * `logging_level` is now a single choice of level of detail. * The pause menu's item list now correctly identifies Pole Spin, and "Health Unit+" is no longer missing from it. * Gem count in minigames is no longer separate from your full count, meaning you don't need to finish a minigame to get its gems. ### Misc. * Significantly refactored chunks of the codebase to be better designed and easier to maintain. * Added client command `/costs`. * Nearly every location has been renamed for less verbosity. * "Generics" filler items are now "Shinies". * Added 270 gems from Stormy Beach to the gem logic system that were missed. * Condensed a few YAML options for simplicity. * Locations are now sorted on the tracker page in order of vanilla game levels, then alphabetically by logical region, then alphabetically by location.

entry.title: Dwarf Fortress v2.1.1
entry.content:
A fix-only release. **2.1.0 and 2.0.x seeds and worlds stay playable** - the item and location tables are untouched, so nothing needs regenerating to install this.
### Fixes
- **Fixed the crash when cancelling a workshop job** (#184). The JOB_COMPLETED event was registered at frequency 1, but DFHack requires 0 to tell a job the player cancelled from one that finished - at 1 both arrive as "completed". The handler then walked the job's item refs, which DF has already freed on a cancel, and dereferencing those crashed the game. The same bug also let a cancelled job increment the craftsanity counts. - Deferred job and building removals no longer hold a raw pointer across their one-tick delay; cancelling the job inside that window left the callback dereferencing freed memory, which `pcall` cannot catch. They now re-find by id. - **Fixed the empty AP shop.** A material lookup indexed `world.raws.inorganics` instead of its `.all` list, which raises rather than returning nil, aborting the caravan poll step before any goods were injected. Only worlds whose raws contain the AP_SHOP materials were affected, which is every world generated with 2.1.0. - **Fixed the shop being skipped when two caravans share the depot.** Every shop decision keyed off whichever merchant happened to be first in `units.active`, so a dwarf caravan arriving alongside the gorlaks silently cost the whole visit. - AP goods are never removed from a unit's inventory, which closes the one way the caravan code could corrupt a live unit, and a stolen good no longer registers as a purchase. Wildlife that steals a good is struck down so the good is recovered. - Each caravan poll step is guarded on its own, so a failure in the cosmetic naming pass can no longer stop goods being injected or purchases detected. This should resolve the issue of Gorlak caravan's coming without any AP goods, as well.

entry.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong v0.5.0
entry.content:
Doing the jump from 0.4.7 to 0.5.0 so people don't stay behind misguidedly thinking that these are small changes. Thanks once again for all the bug reporters and mappers for helping making this project advance in ways never thought fathomable. I will however as per usual throw out my offer [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) for the crunch week If you report issues from any 0.4.x versions that don't apply to this I am not perceiving you. Good luck have fun
### Major
- Adaptive extra inventory page that depending on goal/settings shows what's needed, tracks flea amounts (including when caravan departures are ready), recently obtained items and more - Deep Docks, Far Fields and Underworks got a complete logic rework. Other areas got minor overhauls as well - Steel Soul support - Complete Boss-Sanity and Wish-Sanity rework. It worked from our testing but it can be risky so be aware of that when bringing it to syncs. Bosses now have credit attached to them with their respective story flags (e.g. Boss Credit: Widow) so defeating Widow doesn't automatically unhaunt Bellhart but where ever the credit is. Wish-sanity now shuffles stuff that's on wish boards but remember that something being available early doesn't mean that it's finish-able in logic right then but instead whenever the requirements for it are fulfilled - Added Silk Heart Logic option (on by default, whether silk hearts should be required for some abilities to be in logic for routes) - Added start inventory from pool option - Added Shader Trap option with Oil Painting and Grayscale effects (by Skai) - Added Literacy Trap option where hand-picked copypasta textboxes appear for the player to go through while the action continues around them - Added optional Act 3 Memento randomization - Added optional Act 3 Everbloom randomization - Added optional Diving Bell key randomization. With it on you need the shaman quest AND diving bell key to use it instead of just shaman quest with it disabled - Added "Flea Brew Jump Logic" option, defaulting to false (separate from stalls, this is about drinking it to make certain platforming possible) - Added separate Ventrica Prices, Bench Prices, and Miscellaneous Prices settings. Citadel map machines now follow Map Prices. Miscellaneous Prices covers Pilgrim’s Rest admission and pin gallery fees - Added separate Sharpdart logic option where when enabled, sharpdart can be a logical requirement to gap horizontal movement
### Minor
- Fixed Marrow Jail access incorrectly requiring Widow - Fixed shop-list icons remaining outdated after item previews load - Removed F4 blocker during Abyss escape sequence - F3/Connection HUD no longer breaks on certain resolutions - First time connection now shows archipelago.gg instead of localhost as host to reduce confusion - Silk Soar cannot be used while cloakless - Moorwing now always spawns in his act 2 location and is no longer doomed to only hold filler/useful. Map marker is updated to reflect that - Fixed *that one* Sinners Road entrance being mistakenly being labeled as free despite needing to be opened from other side - Cylinders and Grand Bellway no longer enter Act 1's extra item pool - Act 1 now includes Eva rewards supported by its available crests (not all due to limited pool) - Fixed The Marrow Memory Locket incorrectly appearing in logic without Cling Grip - Releasing Beastling Call could prevent the encounter from appearing while its boss check remained unfinished - Fixed several multiworld auto-collect issues affecting story requirements, map logic and the Abyss shrine - Adjusted camera visibility in Memorium’s Karak and Mossy rooms while keeping breakable walls intact - Added a gap in the opened Far Fields bridge to preserve the tall wind route toward Greymoor - Boss Sanity credit popups now display the corresponding boss’s journal icon - Removed Herobrine - F4 now works during ordinary swimming while retaining the existing safety checks - Bell Beast’s first release now correctly records Marrow as its location - With assembled Farsight, finishing the game even outside of act 3 shows completion percentage - Removed the inaccessible Shellwood Shell Shard Caches 7-8 - Fixed the Shellwood Shell Shard Caches 1-2 not giving their reward when breaking them - Equipped tools now correctly follow Alphabet Mode, crest-slot reward hints remain readable - Corrected the Sawtooth Circlet icon (by Skai) - Improved cleanup of temporary effects and toll-price objects - Added a second lever to the left side of Greymoors bridge so logic can be safe without assuming it's never open - Fixed benches checking whether Shakra’s Quill was purchased, ignoring the randomized Quill players received - Fixed an issue where maps could still look incomplete after using the Quill until the game was restarted - Expanded the trap disguise setting with some hand-picked names - Hornet picks up shinies faster - Added a bell item group

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.12
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/), or click your name on the room page to open it with the host, port and slot name already filled in
## Heads up
- **Regenerate your yaml.** Two options changed shape: `traps` is now `trap_percentage`, any number from 0 to 100, and `shop_hints` is a choice of `off`, `important_only` or `all` that replaces Important Hints Only. A yaml still carrying the old keys keeps working for this release and is read the way it always was. - **A game already in progress keeps working.** Reload the site. A seed generated before 1.8.12 keeps its old shop rules; support for those seeds ends in November 2026, after which you will need a new seed. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**. - The apworld and the site are versioned separately from here on. The seed now says which apworld made it, and the site says so when that is newer than the site.
## Shop Checks seeds could be unbeatable
With Shop Checks on and Progressive Shop off, logic treated the first nine rows of Town's shop as free and later rows as needing only a boss gate. The game stocks a Town row only once a specific stage has been beaten, so about one seed in three put a stage unlock in a row that could never open.
Logic now follows the game's own stock table exactly: a Town row needs a stage that stocks it to be beatable, and Village, Resort and Island are stocked the moment you can walk in, as they are in the base game. A test fills seeds and sweeps them under the game's rule.
## Options
- **Trap Percentage** replaces Traps. The old choice could be typed as `traps: 5` and be read as the fifth choice, which was 100 percent. - **Shop Hints** is one choice: `off`, `important_only`, `all`. - **Progressive Shop** and **Enforce Shop Logic** do nothing unless Shop Checks is on. - **Gold per Thrown Ring** is Ring Link's payout and does nothing without Ring Link. - The options page is grouped by theme, and the yaml template follows the same order. - Every option's help text lives in the template and on the options page; the README no longer keeps its own list.
## Universal Tracker
The tracker can rebuild the world from the seed alone; it no longer needs your yaml.
## The site
- Clicking the game after chatting gives the keyboard back. Escape leaves the chat, and the Send button no longer keeps focus, which is what made a space pause the game. - With Enforce Logic on, clicking a barred stage says which gate it waits on and what that gate still needs. The site also says so when a seed carries no logic to enforce. - `!hint stage` and `!hint class` skip what the room has already been told. A plain `!hint` goes to the server again. - Trap Disguise never hints a disguised trap, a trap wears a different face in every seed, and never the name of another trap. - The -50% gold trap no longer broadcasts over Ring Link. - Iron and Bronze Medals multiply the XP and drop multipliers, the way the Gold Medal already did for gold. - A fully wiped party revives for free. - Switching tabs mid-walk no longer leaves a ranger walking. - Shop checks sent from another client on your slot, or by a collect, are picked up as they happen. - A shop check holding progression or a trap wears its own tile; the art is now named for what it means.

entry.title: Ys Origin v1.9.2r4
entry.content:
> 🧪 **Still a beta.** Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**. > > ⚠️ **Copy all three files, and start a fresh seed.** Most fixes are in the apworld, and location ids have changed (unreachable checks were removed and one was added), so a beta 4 seed won't line up with this apworld. Players mid-run on a beta 4 seed can still take the **DLL** alone: it brings every mod-side fix below.
See [beta 1](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.1) for the full 2.0 change list. Everything since then is included.
## 🗺️ Room logic, rebuilt from the game's own data
Until now, the room-to-room logic was largely hand-written, and much of it was wrong. Every zone has now been rebuilt from the game's exit tables (the `.SEN` records that say where each door leads) and from the room scripts that check items. In several zones most of the connections were wrong:
- **Wailing Blue:** the 4-statue barrier and the Blue Necklace. Walking around the barrier from the 5F statue is no longer in logic, and Toal now needs the **Bronze Key** (which leads to Boost) instead of the necklace. - **Flooded Prison:** 17 of 25 rooms were wrong. The **Arthropod Medallion** now guards the door to Nygtilger, which it never did before. **Water Dragon's Scales** are required only where the water is always deep and your air never refills. - **Flames of Guilt:** 20 of 27 rooms were wrong. Gelaldy is behind the **Construct Medallion** door, and the Crimson Lotusblade gates are gone because nothing in the game checks for it. **The 11F noise room is now gated:** - Hugo needs the **Hammer**. - Yunica needs the **Silver Harmonica** and the song from the Flames Roo. - Toal walks through it on Boost. - **Silent Sands:** almost entirely rewritten. The Marble Key, Amber Key, Creeper Medallion, Earth Dragon's Claws, Silver Chimes (for the Zarue pit) and Gold Bracelet (for the ledges) now sit on the doors and slopes they actually guard. - **Corrupted Blood:** the Crimson Key, Dragonbone Key and Mantid Medallion doors are in their real places, and the pits are one-way. - **Demonic Core:** the **Rod** now gates the mirror maze; before this it wasn't even required. The win is reaching the summit through the **Devil Medallion** door.
## 💍 Rado's Annex door could never open for Yunica or Hugo
The door checks that you're **holding the drained Evil Ring** *and* that you own the charged one. AP only ever gave you the charged one, so there was nothing to hold. Receiving the Evil Ring now gives you both, just as the Zelkaron fight does in the normal game. **Equip the Blue Necklace before you hold the ring:** without it the ring kills you, as in the normal game, and the logic requires both.
## 🚫 Checks that could never be sent
These checks can no longer hold someone's progression: - Chests the game deletes for some characters are now restricted to the characters who can open them: - Wailing Blue 3F midboss chest (Hugo only) and 2F Path 1 #3 (Yunica and Toal). - The Flooded Prison Cleria Ore chest in S_2005 (Toal only). - Flames of Guilt 10F Path 2 #2 (Toal only). - Silent Sands: Mask of Eyes Path (Yunica and Hugo). - Toal's Room (Toal only). - Eyes of Fact and the stun blessing (one character each). - Six "Explore" checks in rooms no door leads to are removed. - **New check:** Yunica's harmonica from the Kishgal duel. Silent Sands' harmonica check is now Hugo's and Toal's.
## 🏁 Goals
- **Yunica and Hugo** now report the goal reliably. It triggers on the final fight's story flags as well as the ending scene. - **`goal: defeat_all_bosses` actually works now.** Before, nothing ever checked it. It now needs all six floor bosses defeated and in logic.
## 🛒 Statue shop
- **A higher tier is never cheaper or reachable earlier than the tiers below it.** One player found the Blue Moon Crest behind LV3 of the most expensive item. Shop slots are also gated on the SP they actually cost, including seeds with vanilla prices. - **Rows show the right name and price.** Armor and leggings rows sometimes showed a blessing's price ("Not enough SP" while you had enough), and blessings with the same price could swap labels. - **F5 shop with blessing items:** buying now sends the check instead of handing out the effect for free.
## 🩹 Softlocks and bugs
- **Stuck on 1F after Kishgal** ("I'm just a burden…", no stairs, no warp). The fix now detects this state reliably and lets the scene with Roy play out. - **Dreaming Idol:** the check is Yunica's only and sits where its story event actually is. The usable idol is no longer suppressed, and a stuck idol chain is repaired. - **MP regen stopped, then MP dropped to about −650%:** the fire skill could reach level 4. It's now capped at 3, and existing saves are repaired. - **Receiving a progressive Fire skill sent the Fire Altar check.** - **Crash on New Game** (not reproduced): the unchecked memory reads on that path are now guarded.
## 🐞 Known, still open
These need a live check, so please report what you see: - **Silent Sands:** whether the upper ledges need the Gold Bracelet, the slopes need the Claws, and the cracked wall to the Zarue pit needs Thunder. - **Toal crossing the 11F noise room without Boost.** Only relevant in open mode. - **Suppressed vanilla events still play their dialogue.** For example, the Zelkarons still announce that the Evil Ring is charged.
If something goes wrong, please send `yso_ap_mod.log` from `%TEMP%`.
---
**Install:** `ys_origin.apworld` into `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.1
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **Servers work again on the 2026-10-05 TF2 update.** The update changed how the game finds an item attribute by its name, and three things broke: - On Windows, TF2Attributes did not find that function and refused to load. The Archipelago plugin and the defender bots need it, so the server started with neither. - On both platforms, TF Econ Data read part of the item list 36 bytes off, which gave the bots wrong cosmetic slots and unusual effects. This release patches it until TF Econ Data ships its own fix. - SigMod crashed the server the first time somebody drew a weapon, on both platforms. Its list of custom attributes named one attribute twice, and the game now refuses that. SigMod linux-20261006 and 20261006 drop the duplicate, and the Windows build has the addresses for the new TF2 build. We played SigMod missions with defender bots on the new TF2 build. The team won all 12 waves on Windows and 11 of 12 on Linux. The other Linux wave stalls the same way it did before the update. The bots bought their upgrades on both platforms. - **Bot Surge adds its extra support robots on Windows.** The plugin never found a function that this part of Bot Surge needs on Windows, so it did nothing there. - **Bot Surge no longer crashes the server on Brain Taker's last wave.** Some community missions leave a pickup behind for every robot that dies, and it stays until somebody on RED walks over it. At Bot Surge's spawn rate those pickups filled the server's entity limit within about ten minutes and the server crashed. Bot Surge now slows down to the mission's own pace when the server gets close to the limit, and speeds back up once there is room again. - **A room going down no longer wipes the run.** When an archipelago.gg room closes, its port can be handed to a different multiworld. The bridge reconnected to that one, took it for a new run and started your progress over, even though that room then refused to let it in. The bridge now only switches runs once a room has accepted your slot. And if you go back to a room you played here before, its run comes back as you left it instead of starting empty. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(plugin): pause Bot Surge before the map runs out of edicts by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/190 * fix(bridge): bind the seed once the room accepts the slot by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/191 * fix(bots): gamedata for TF2 11087207 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/194 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.0...v1.18.1 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/OGRkYmU0MjM0Yzc2NTY4YmNiMDBjNjczNTJhMjI0MmI6MTc5MTI5NDY0Ng==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NTU0NWRmYTQ2ZGM3MzhhNDcwODRiNTBhMTg5NmVlNDM6MTc5MTI5NDY0OQ==/detection)

entry.title: Sternly Worded Adventures v1.0.0r2
entry.content:
**SWAP v1.1** The first major patch to the mod, adding various new features, fixing several bugs/crashes, and some quality of life improvements!
**New Features** - Deathlink support both ways! Now whenever someone dies, they can be scolded for their skill issues, be it you or your friends! - Trap items can now be enabled. They come in three flavours: Fire, Enemy Heal, and Board Break. - Letter randomisation: the APWorld now has an option to disable the ability for a number of letters to generate in-game. You then require a 'Letter Unlock: {Letter}' item in order for a locked letter to generate. - Consumables obtained during a run now carry over between resets instead of being lost entirely. - Due to the V53 update, more standard reward pools are now available to the Wayfarer class from merchant events, shops, etc. I decided to keep this in order to make the experience more forgiving for the average player.
**Bug Fixes** - Random merchant events no longer crash the game if the player doesn't decline them. - Fixed a bug where the Endless Potion Bag didn't give potions when used, but AP-items instead. - Fixed a bug where if the game somehow closed or crashed during reward screens, the item on said screen would be lost. - Miscellaneous technical changes to prevent potential issues that haven't been documented yet.
**Planned improvements** - Additional checks for shops and other location types or actions. - A few options in the .apworld to alter world generation (like potentially removing Lost Woods nodes for example). - Separate all AP-related save data into its own file that is saved separately instead of saving it in persistent save data. - Assign a server/port to the item transfer file so it's easier to participate in multiple runs simultaneously. - Make the rewards hook smarter; make it skip rewards that have been auto-collected or are otherwise empty to save players' time.

entry.title: Yakuza Gaiden v0.8.0
entry.content:
## Update notes, and goals for the next build
More fun mythology before the patch notes, first a recap:
I name the builds based all around the myth of the carp climbing the waterfall to become a dragon, because c'mon this is a yakuza randomizer! We started with varieties of fish pre AP integration, then moved to monstrous fish, or dragon fish, since. And on release will likely move to dragon names!
This one is named Namazu, which is named after a large catfish monster whose thrashing would cause violent earthquakes across Japan, until eventually restrained by a god. Chosen due to the earthquake like effects of migrating everything to exist within the AP world rather than needing multiple files. We finally got everything wrapped up into one file! the earthquakes are no more!
Less massive of a release than last time, no real major features within the rando have been added this build. As the goal here was to make a ton of Quality of Life changes like combining the text client with the game console!
There are still logic changes and bug fixes included however, so it should be a better experience overall.
Next version will focus on actual new functionality for the rando itself, maybe bringing in some existing features from other mods like the enemy randomizer mod or incorporating a way to adjust world events for new progression and cooler locked items... but nothing for sure yet!
That being said, there's no better time to play then now! Every build gets a bit more efficient, clean, and fun. So like always, if you test it out and have an issue, please reach out to me either through discord, submitting an issue through Github, or make a post on the AP Afterdark page for Gaiden.
The new code is stored in the Archipelago branch which has existed since early on, but the releases will stay here for keeping things consistent for archival. Here is a link to that Github in case you want to see the new code:
https://github.com/zorasknight/Archipelago
## Yakuza Gaiden Randomizer Version 0.8.0 (Namazu)
- There is no longer a separate Yakuza Gaiden Randomizer, it is now baked into the Yakuza Gaiden AP World Client! This means I highly recommend re-reading the Readme to understand the new installs going forward. - A standard Text Client has been created for Yakuza Gaiden! This allows you to handle all the normal bits and bobs through the custom text client rather than using the console. including connecting, hinting, releasing etc. I recommend having the client connected before starting the game so that the console can auto connect using the information. - You can now double click on your slot name to launch the Gaiden text client and auto connect to the slot. - Full Universal Tracker Support built in, which does still mean you need to download the universal tracker ap world, but assuming you have that already (I recommend updating to the most recent build!) you should have access to the tracker map for each region as well as all the newer bells and whistles that it includes. - Full Map Tracking included with the universal tracker! This took quite a bit of time, but you should now have access to a map tracker so long as you have universal tracker installed. - YAML-Less support for Universal Tracker, You no longer need to make sure the correct player yaml is in your players folder, universal tracker will collect the information you need from your slot information! - Logic bug fixes for random tasks, substories, and some pocket circuit logic fixes - Hints added for substories on accepting them to decide whether pursuing them is worth it - Hint fixes for tasks to catch some loose fetch and trial tasks - YAML fixes for minigame keys - Setting fixes in general for better stability - PC car fixes to make sure every slot in a rando seed has unique parts distributed - Many small stability fixes for the client

entry.title: Creeper World 4 v0.2.1
entry.content:
Matched pair: install the plugin zip AND regenerate with this `cw4.apworld`. The plugin and the apworld share a version number and must match.
Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
**Existing yamls keep working**, and a yaml that names no new setting means what it meant before. Seeds do change: a solo or all-Creeper-World-4 seed number generates a different layout than it did in v0.2.0, because the early weapon is now actually placed early.
- **Fixed: `early_weapon` did nothing when every player was Creeper World 4**, solo included, from v0.1.3 to v0.2.0. The option asks Archipelago to place the chosen weapon - and a second mission unlock - in the checks you can reach with nothing. But on those seeds the world places its own progression first, so it can retry where Archipelago's fill would give up, and it took both items out of the pool before Archipelago looked for them. Nothing warned. Measured over 10,000 solo seeds: the chosen weapon came first on 38 percent of them, the early unlock on 11. The world now places both itself, first. - **Fixed: in a multiworld with other games, a narrow opening asked for nothing early.** Casual logic at 2 starters, or a SPAN draw with only one check open at the start, stood its requests down for a bootstrap that only runs when every player is Creeper World 4. 13 to 48 percent of CW4 players in those multiworlds got neither. They now get the requests. When only one check is open, the mission unlock gets it. - **Measured, not assumed.** A new tool, `tools/audit/earlysweep.py`, generates through the same path a player's seed takes and checks where the items actually LAND. 10,000 seeds in each of seven shapes - solo, two and four CW4 players, and CW4 beside ChecksFinder, VVVVVV, Meritous and Timespinner: 0 generation failures, 0 unreachable or unbeatable seeds, and the weapon and the unlock early in every one that asked. As a side effect the world's own fill now has to retry 7 to 20 times less often. - **Placements change.** A solo or all-CW4 seed number generates a different layout than it did in v0.2.0, and so does a mixed multiworld whose CW4 opening is narrow; any other mixed multiworld is unchanged. `tools/span-off-parity.sh` and `tools/refactor-parity.sh` report the difference, by design. - **The yaml is short now.** `Creeper World 4.yaml` used to be the template Archipelago generates, 635 lines of its own boilerplate and of notes written for whoever maintains the world. It is now written by hand, 120 lines: each option at its default with a line or two on what it does and the values it takes, in the order of the options page - Archipelago's own progression balancing and accessibility first, as in its official template, then the goal and logic, traps, energy upgrades and ERNs. The descriptions on the options page are rewritten for players as well; the design notes moved into the code. - **New: `logic_difficulty: easy`.** Casual asks for a Sniper OR a Missile Launcher from We Were Never Alone (mission 6) onward. Easy asks the same until The Experiment (mission 13) - the designer's "small spike in map difficulty", where the worksheet calls snipers, missiles and a cannon over a mortar all worth having - and from there all four of Sniper, Missile Launcher, Cannon and Mortar. Like casual it counts by story number, so every SPAN map gets all four, and it gates every check on those missions except the free caches. The in-game tracker needs no update: it reads the requirements from the seed, so a check missing one of the four shows yellow. Measured over 21,000 seeds in seven multiworld shapes - solo, two and four CW4 players, and CW4 beside one to four other games: 0 generation failures, and the early weapon still lands early. - **Four options that do nothing are hidden** from the options page and the yaml: `trap_weight_emitter_overdrive` and the three `filler_*_weight` options. A yaml that still names them generates as before.

entry.title: BKClown v0.0.1r2
entry.content:
## Bugfixes: - Fixed Logic
## Requirements:
- A Steam Copy of FFPS (Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator)
- Windows
## Setup:
- Create a folder named "BKCLOWN" in your main archipelago folder (or launching the client should do this automatically). - Move your Steam copy of FFPS into the folder. - Open the client, and run /patch. - Open up the .exe titled BKCLOWN.exe and connect to your archipelago server in the top bar! - Enjoy!

entry.title: Friday Night Funkin v2.3.1r2
entry.content:
Heya. Technically speaking, this is more of a "Beta" than anything, but considering the whole project is a beta, it's more like a Beta for a Beta type deal.
# Anyways, here's what's up.
### On the Engine Side of things, we got: * Fixed a small bug with the Warm-Up settings so that it actually stops showing up if you pick "Never" * Made the strum skins work properly now * Pixel Note Skins now share the same loading scheme as the regular notes (so that skins don't break if you use anything other then default) * The `onPlayAnimPre` call now includes the character that called it (function argument values are as follows in order: `curCharacter, AnimName, Force, Reversed, Frame`) * Adjusted the Modchart System to (hopefully) better actually run modcharts (or worse, I didn't really test it that well) * Introducing: FunkinMemory! With this bad boy (courtesy of V-Slice, btw), I can only pray the memory issue that's been happening will be, at best, resolved, and at worst, slower to happen than the previous builds were. *
### On the APWorld Side of things, we got: * Updated the APWorld for 6.8.0 (It now gets through pre-gen, as god intended) * Uses APAPI, a WIP helper for both Players and Devs! Currently, optional, but will speed up generation if you have it.
Yeah, that's it. Light, right? Well, we weren't kidding about working on the rewrite, and so far so good on that. No promises, but I guarantee it won't take nearly as long as Week 8 did LMAO
Anyways, that's it. Go play now.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Z11Coding/Mixtape-Engine-Rework/compare/beta13.2...beta13.3

entry.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past v1.6.1
entry.content: * Door shuffle no longer forces small keys to be shuffled * Fixed a bug where key pots weren't sending items with key drop shuffle enabled for pots, but disabled for enemy drops * Fixed Mimic Cave enemies having the wrong logical requirements for Hammer and Boomerang * Fixed a generation crash when the Sprite option was missing * You can no longer start with a Chicken. Or various other junk items that crashed the game on startup * Completionist goal description now states that pendants, crystals, and Agahnims are required
